points.point: Why Blotato mutes the music on a TikTok video after posting
Video (not slideshow) on TikTok, music plays when uploaded manually

verdict.reason: No entry explains why Blotato would mute a TikTok video's music; the closest, tiktok-slideshow-no-music, only says autoAddMusic has no effect on videos, and the other entries cover Instagram, slideshows, or unrelated topics, and the issue also depends on this account's own post, so a person should review it.
